column1: # For ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 land-cover classes
# Resistance values are illustrative and should be calibrated for specific species/ecological contexts
# Classes with traversable=0 are treated as blocked (infinite resistance)
# Higher resistance = more difficult/costly for wildlife movement

column5: Dense forest / tree cover — most suitable habitat, lowest resistance
Shrubland / sparse vegetation — moderate habitat suitability
Grassland — suitable for many species, moderate resistance
Cropland / agricultural land — fragmented, higher resistance
Built-up / urban areas — effectively impassable, blocked
Bare ground / sparse vegetation — high resistance
Permanent snow and ice — blocked for most terrestrial species
Permanent water — species-dependent, generally high resistance
Moss and lichen — sparse high-latitude vegetation, higher resistance
